wellbeing.roughHelp: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.locksHelp: Vala isici isonto elilodwa, amasonto amabili, inyanga, noma unomphela. Inkinga, usizo lokubuyela emuva, oxhumana nabo abaphephile nokusula idatha akusoze kwavalwa.

community.noPhone: Izinombolo zocingo azikaze ziboniswe ekuthumeleni imiyalezo.

support.resourcesNote: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.meetingsTitle: Imihlangano yezinyathelo eziyishumi nambili nokubuyiselwa kwemali

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Gcina umxhasi noma othintana naye ekude.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: Lokhu kususa ngempela idatha yakho futhi akunakulungiswa.
safety.wipeConfirm: Ngiyaqonda ukuthi lokhu kususa ngempela idatha yami.

reentry.tipPlaceholder: Yini eyakusiza ukuba wenze lesi sinyathelo?
reentry.celebrationAll: Zonke izinyathelo ezingu-33 sezenziwe. Gubha intuthuko yakho.
reentry.crisisStep: Londoloza lezi zinombolo manje. Ungaphinde ucindezele Ngidinga usizo manje phezulu kwesikrini ngasinye.
reentry.resourceOnly: Isikhombi somthombo kuphela — Groundwork asihlinzeki ngalokhu noma sisebenzisana nabahlinzeki.

steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Hlola amaphepha akho okudedelwa nezinsuku zokugcina
steps.step10: Qinisekisa usuku nezimo zokuhlola kwakho kokuqala
steps.step13: Thola ucingo, i-e-mail nokufinyelela mahhala kuyi-Internet
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step29: Vula i-akhawunti yasebhange futhi wenze isabelomali
steps.step31: Buyisana nomkhaya wakho, futhi unakekele imali yesondlo somntwana uma kudingeka
steps.step33: Beka umgomo owodwa wesikhathi eside bese ugubha usuku lwakho lwezinsuku ezingu-90

work.paroleNote: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.

journey.portfolioPrivate: Okuyimfihlo ngokuzenzakalelayo. Yabelana kuphela uma ukhetha.

venue.placeholder: Izithombe zendawo yangempela azinikezwanga; lesi akusona isikhala sangempela.

family.help: Amalungu omkhaya abona kuphela lokho okhetha ukwabelana ngakho.

readAloud.title: Ukufunda ngokuzwakalayo
readAloud.help: Ukufunda ngokuzwakalayo kusebenzisa izwi lensiza yakho ukuze kufundwe umbhalo ngokuzwakalayo.

phase3.resumeHelp: Yakha i-CV elula esekelwe kokuhlangenwe nakho kwakho.
phase3.headline: Isihloko
phase3.interviewHelp: Umqeqeshi wakho unikeza amaphuzu nesipho esisodwa.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.geoHelp: Idolobha lakho kuphela eliboniswa abanye. Indawo eqondile ayikaze yabelwe.
phase3.rideHelp: Cela umgibeli, izinombolo zocingo aziboniswa, sihlangane endaweni yomphakathi.
phase3.caption: Isihlokwana
phase3.qaHelp: Buza ngokungaziwa, izimpendulo zivela kumalungu akude.
phase3.merchHelp: Akukho lutho ngaphandle okusho ukuthi asho ukuthini, futhi azikho izinsuku ezinyathelisiwe.
phase3.shareHelp: Ikhadi elilodwa elibonisa intuthuko yakho liyabalwa.
phase3.matchHelp: I-ejenti yakho ikhuluma namanye ama-ejenti kuqala, ukuqomisana kuyasuswa okwamanje, ungabona ukuthi kungani, unganaki ukuthi cha, bese uphinda.
phase3.datingOff: Ukuqomisana akuvunyelwe kuze kube yilapho sekubekwe umthetho wezinsuku ezincane.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Indawo yokuqala okufanele ubheke kuyo. Ukungena ngemvume, ezingeni ledolobha kuphela: bheka ukuthi ubani oya emhlanganweni wakho bese uxhuma ngemiyalezo ese-app. Azikho izinombolo zocingo, azikho izindawo eziqondile.
phase3.groupsHelp: Amaqembu okululama, amaqembu asekelayo okubuyela ekhaya, kanye namaqembu enkolo nawomphakathi ngedolobha nangesikhathi somhlangano.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Kuboniswa kuphela uma kungekho muntu ebhodini lokuxhumana ohamba emhlanganweni wakho. Ukuthumela isicelo esenziwe ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza — kuphela ezingeni ledolobha, azikho izinombolo zocingo.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Ayikho imoto efanelekayo kulo mhlangano, ngakho i-Needs a Ride iboniswa njengesipele.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Abashayeli abagunyaziwe kuphela. Ama-ping ahamba ngawodwana nge-timeout yemizuzu emi-2; uyaqinisekisa ngaphambi kokuba kutholakale oxhumana naye olandelayo.
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.musicHelp: Amathrekhi ayisampula kuphela, awekho ama-akhawunti okusakaza, isidlali sivala ngaphakathi kwe-academy kanye namamojula ezifundo.
phase3.shareWho: Okwamanje: nguwe wedwa. Ukwenza isixhumanisi kuvumela noma ubani onesixhumanisi ukuba asifunde.
phase3.suggestHelp: Iziphakamiso kuphela — akukho lutho olushicilelwayo uze ulufake.
